models.name: MiniMax H3 Image
models._note: Open-weight text-to-image + image-editing model from the MiniMax H3 family (API model MiniMax-H3-Image, Standard mode). Release per MiniMax release notes 'Nov. 10, 2026' (launch blog dated 2026-11-11; HF repo created 2026-11-03). 33.1B dense single-stream DiT (50 layers), H3 architecture without audio layers, MiniMax-H3 (Qwen3-VL) text encoder unchanged; 6-step distilled, no CFG; ~16 MP output (4096x4096 up to 6272x2688); up to 16 reference images. MiniMax-H3-Image Community License. Optional prompt expander MiniMax-H3-Image-PE (NVFP4).

models.name: MiniMax H3 Image Highspeed
models._note: API-only Highspeed serving mode of MiniMax H3 Image (model name MiniMax-H3-Image-Highspeed): same model, higher price per token, lower latency (blog: Standard 1.5-2x, Highspeed 3-4x as fast as mainstream alternatives).

benchmarks.name: Remote Labor Index — Elo (paper v1, human baseline = 1000)
benchmarks.description: Remote Labor Index pairwise Elo from the RLI paper (arXiv 2510.26787v1, Table 3): AI deliverables compared pairwise on project completion and overall quality across the 230-project private set; scores canonicalized so the human baseline is 1,000 (higher is better).

benchmarks.name: Remote Labor Index — dollars earned (paper v1, of $143,991)
benchmarks.description: Remote Labor Index economic metric from the RLI paper (arXiv 2510.26787v1, Table 4): sum of the human deliverable cost over projects the agent completed at an acceptable level, out of a maximum of $143,991 (higher is better).
